// diagnostic E-ERR-PROPAGATE

Jet.BareQuestionMark

A bare `?` has no meaning.

What

A bare `?` has no meaning.

Why

A bare `?` marks a call that can fail (`call()?`); `?(text)` adds one failure-context frame to any fallible value.

Fix

Remove the trailing `?`, or write `?(text)` to add one context frame.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.BareQuestionMark: Tests/UI/bare_call_question_before_paren.stderr.

Error: Jet.BareQuestionMark: A bare `?` has no meaning.
  --> Tests/UI/bare_call_question_before_paren.jet:6:30
    |
  6 | run: fn() { print(parse("ab")?) }
    |                              ^
 Why: Fallible calls propagate automatically; `?(text)` is reserved for adding one failure-context frame.
 Fix: Remove the trailing `?`, or write `?(text)` to add one context frame.
